title: UN Comtrade — Pacific Member Merchandise Trade
description: Bilateral merchandise trade by HS commodity for Samoa, Fiji, Tonga, Vanuatu, PNG, Solomon Islands and Kiribati.
notes: Most complete commodity-level trade source. Comtrade terms of use restrict bulk redistribution — needs human licence review before any resale. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: World Bank WITS — Pacific Trade and Tariff Profiles
description: World Integrated Trade Solution country trade profiles and tariff data for Pacific Island economies.
notes: Aggregates Comtrade, TRAINS and WTO data; rights follow each underlying source, so not CLEAR. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: World Bank WDI — Exports of Goods and Services (% of GDP), Pacific Islands
description: World Development Indicators trade-openness series for Pacific Island countries.
notes: WDI is published under CC BY 4.0. Attribution must also name the national source the World Bank cites (Decision 59). World Bank Indicators API (JSON) for this seed's own indicator NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS; per_page=1000 returns every year for all seven countries in one response. Stage 02b: direct data-file URL, not live-verified (build sandbox has no outbound network to this host) — confirm with a live fetch before relying on it.

title: Pacific Trade Invest — Export Market Reports
description: Pacific Islands Forum trade promotion agency market reports and export statistics.
notes: Exporter-facing intelligence, mostly PDF reports — good test of document extraction. No reuse licence stated. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: Pacific Data Hub .Stat — International Merchandise Trade Statistics
description: SPC-curated international merchandise trade statistics for Pacific Island countries and territories.
notes: Regionally curated alternative to Comtrade. Licence varies by dataflow; not confirmed for this one. PDH.stat IMTS dataflow (DF_IMTS) as SDMX-CSV. Stage 02b: direct data-file URL, not live-verified (build sandbox has no outbound network to this host) — confirm with a live fetch before relying on it.
